description: Defines a custom allocator and a vector class (FatVector) with internal preallocated buffer for efficient small-size storage, used within the Android project.

classes.name: InlineStdAllocator
classes.description: A custom allocator that uses a fixed-size internal buffer for small allocations, falling back to malloc for larger ones.

classes.name: FatVector
classes.description: A std::vector subclass with a small internal buffer to optimize for small sizes.

methods.name: allocate
methods.description: Allocates memory either from internal buffer or via malloc.

methods.name: deallocate
methods.description: Deallocates memory, returning internal buffer to free if used.

methods.name: FatVector()
methods.description: Default constructor initializing internal buffer and reserving space.

methods.name: FatVector(std::initializer_list<T> init)
methods.description: Constructor initializing vector with a list of elements.

methods.name: FatVector(size_t capacity)
methods.description: Constructor that resizes the vector to the specified capacity.
